about_short_description.short_description: Powerhouse AI provides automated inventory management services.

product.name: Vision-AI Counting and Data Capture
product.description: A solution that uses AI-vision scanning to automate counting and data capture processes in warehouses, functioning as an add-on to WMS/ERP systems.

product.name: Power Count
product.description: Automates the verification of inbound, outbound, and cycle count processes by checking if the correct goods and quantities are received, stored, or shipped.

product.name: Power Scan
product.description: Identifies and extracts data points from incoming goods, checks outbound shipments, and automates data entry by scanning multiple barcodes and documents.

product.name: Power Docs
product.description: Uses computer vision to read logistics documents, automating data entry and cross-checking between documents and physical inventory or system data.

product.name: Automated Warehouse Inbound and Receiving
product.description: Automates the inbound process to receive inventory faster and reduce human error, improving dock-to-stock times.

identifier.value: Automated AI Cycle Count and Stocktake

product.name: Automated AI Cycle Count and Stocktake
product.description: Enhances inventory tracking and warehouse efficiency by speeding up cycle count and stocktake processes and ensuring accuracy.
